english_title: Example 1.1.3: Necessary Condition for a Local Extremum of a Function
statement_en: If \(x_0\) is a local maximum point of a differentiable function \(f(x)\), prove that $$f'(x_0)=0.$$
final_code:
import Mathlib

theorem local_maximum_derivative_zero
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x₀ : ℝ}
    (hmax : IsLocalMax f x₀)
    (hderiv : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x₀) :
    deriv f x₀ = 0 := by
  sorry
